ai_summary: Ambika Cotton Mills reported strong financial performance in FY2025-26 with 11% revenue growth and 8.85% PAT increase, a positive trend continuing into Q1 FY2026-27, primarily driven by recovering exports. The company maintains a robust debt-free balance sheet, funding significant capital investments like the ₹135-₹138 crore Unit 4 modernization entirely through internal accruals. This reflects a disciplined strategy focused on quality, differentiation, sustainability, and long-term value creation, with no material red flags observed in this forward-looking statement.
